mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teaching_class ( class_id, class_name, course_sequence, course_code, course_name, teacher_id, teacher_name, academic_year, semester, capacity, enrolled_count, class_status, sync_time, sync_source ) VALUES ( #{classId}, #{className}, #{courseSequence}, #{courseCode}, #{courseName}, #{teacherId}, #{teacherName}, #{academicYear}, #{semester}, #{capacity}, #{enrolledCount}, #{classStatus}, #{syncTime}, #{syncSource} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE class_name = #{className}, course_sequence = #{courseSequence}, course_code = #{courseCode}, course_name = #{courseName}, teacher_id = #{teacherId}, teacher_name = #{teacherName}, academic_year = #{academicYear}, semester = #{semester}, capacity = #{capacity}, enrolled_count = #{enrolledCount}, class_status = #{classStatus}, sync_time = #{syncTime}, sync_source = #{syncSource}
